lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnAgSe₂ crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a cell formula of Zn₃Ag₃Se₆ containing 12 atoms distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Zn centers each coordinated by six Se neighbors in octahedral motifs, while each Se center has three Ag and three Zn neighbors, also octahedral, with neighbor distances around 2.71–2.76 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ag and Zn octahedra, and edge-sharing between like Ag and like Zn octahedra.
